tools.name: test_adviser_request
tools.description: Harmless integration test with the same body as request_adviser_contact: validates the request and returns a preview with status validated_test and email_sent false. Use synthetic contact details only. No commercial lead, email, entitlement or payment. Never describe this as a real submission.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_lamal_premiums, request_adviser_contact · Private data: compare_lamal_premiums, get_lamal_metadata, create_adviser_handoff_link, test_adviser_request, request_adviser_contact · Public sink: create_adviser_handoff_link, test_adviser_request, request_adviser_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_lamal_premiums, request_adviser_contact · Private data: compare_lamal_premiums, get_lamal_metadata, create_adviser_handoff_link, test_adviser_request, request_adviser_contact · Public sink: create_adviser_handoff_link, test_adviser_request, request_adviser_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
